articles.title: Police Complaint Filed Against Priyank Kharge Over "AI Image" Post On RSS And Ammunition Haul
articles.summary: Police complaint against Priyank Kharge said the Congress leader knowingly spread false misinformation by linking the RSS to the seizure of over 44,000 live cartridges in Bihar and Haryana

articles.title: TN government launches 'Eri' portal to fast-track process to restore waterbodies
articles.summary: The automated system, which dispenses with the manual application process, aims to clear eligible restoration applications within a strict 15-days window.
